clips.title: The story
paras: Palemane Rock shelters a gnoll camp in Mulgore's western mountains. The Palemane tribe holds the cave and foothills, threatening tauren near Bloodhoof Village.

Palemane Rock lies along Mulgore's western rim, where open grassland meets the mountains. An encampment fronts a deep cave in the mountainside. Palemane gnolls claim the cave and the foothills outside it as their territory. They attack hunters, travelers, and scouts who come too close, and defend their den fiercely.
